payload.headline: Successful HWPX template filling requires handling split XML text elements and clearing layout cache tags to prevent rendering errors.
payload.evidence: Placeholders (e.g., {{key}}) are often split across multiple <hp:t> (text) elements within an <hp:p> (paragraph) due to formatting or metadata. HWPX files contain <hp:lineSegArray> elements within paragraphs that cache text positioning. If these are not removed after text modification, the rendered document will display overlapping characters or incorrect layouts.
payload.mediator_reasoning: The task was successful, but the specific logic required to handle HWPX internals (XML structure and layout cache) is a valuable reflection for future HWPX-related tasks.
